lint_step_detail.root_cause_reported: Per the reviewer (relayed via the dispatcher) and improvement-agent's concurrent investigation: a stray `pac --non-interactive` process from the VS Code Power Platform extension (pid 4389, alive 15h34m, holding the shared MSAL token cache) was identified as the prime suspect and logged as IMP-0216 (applied to knowledge/technology/build-and-deploy.md, review 3). Killing that process did NOT resolve it — `pac org who` hung identically afterward — so IMP-0216's diagnosis was itself incomplete. The reviewer then found and interactively answered a macOS Keychain access permission prompt (a GUI dialog invisible to any automated probe); both `pac org who` (~51s) and `lint` (~35s, matching the documented baseline) then completed cleanly on the first subsequent try. Logged as IMP-0217, correcting IMP-0216. NOTE: the Keychain-prompt mechanism itself is the reviewer's own account — an agent has no shell-visible way to observe a GUI dialog, so that specific causal claim is reported, not agent-verified.
